Art: Xierra099
Story and Dialogue: Me (except for pics 5-8 of this gallery which were written by Xierra in 2021)

My first comic featuring Xierra's OCs. Almost four years ago Xierra did a pin-up of a red haired girl now named Debbie (pic 4 in this gallery) and then did a follow-up monochrome 4 page strip featuring her with another girl now named Eunice (pics 5-8 in this gallery).

Xierra said that she has no plans for these characters and that they are basically "shareware" and anyone can do whatever they want with them. Over the last 4 years to my knowledge only two fanarts were made, so I thought I'd give it a go.

The main goal of this comic is to establish and flesh out the characters of Debbie and Eunice and to give them a very small supporting cast.

This will be updated sporadically every 2-3 months. Mostly ecchi, nudity and comedy, there'll be only two proper sex scenes towards the latter half of the comic.

Enjoy if you can.

Final seven page update of the comic (unless I spot something that needs fixing too late again) on July 5th 2026!

My thanks to Xierra for her hard work on this project. She added a lot of spice to the final scene. My main goals with this comic were to write a decent and engaging story using Xierra's characters and to give Debbie and Eunice distinct personalities, while keeping both of them likable. Hopefully I've succeeded.

Thanks for reading.

Next comic will be very self-indulgent and will involve a Sona self-insert. I'll post that one in full once it's finished rather than in batches like this comic.
